Name: Coordinated Crafting Bars
Author: yifalchunbee
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][size=5][b][i]Update as of 3/18/2017:[/i][/b][/size][size=4][i] [/i]Fixed the borked cave crystals. (Oops.) Please redownload![/size]
[b][i]Update as of 10/4/2016[/i]:[/b][/size][size=4] Added new files compatible with version 1.1. Please redownload![/size]

[u][size=5][b]Summary[/b][/size][/u]

[/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]The size discrepancies between bars - noticeably refined quartz (too small) and iridium (too big) - annoyed me. Well, no more! All bars are now equal sizing and similar in shading. It's a simple pixel edit of five sprites, but trust me, it makes a huge difference.[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS]

[size=5][b][u]Notes
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]
Copper, iron, gold, and refined quartz are the same between V.1 and V.2.
V.1 Iridium is a light pink with yellow-ish highlights, whereas V.2 iridium is a dark purple with magenta-ish highlights. I couldn't decide which I liked better, so I'll leave that up to you. Choose wisely!

[s]As of now, "Coordinated Crafting Bars" is only (?) compatible with version 1.07. Whenever I get the 1.1 update (I use the GOG version, not Steam), I'll update the mod accordingly.[/s]
[/size]

[b][u][size=5]Installation / Uninstallation
[/size][/u][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]To install, extract the archive and drop "springobjects.xnb" into ...\Stardew Valley\Content\[b]Maps[/b] (NOT ...[b]\[/b]Stardew Valley\Content.) Make sure to backup your files in case you want to revert to the original sprites![/size][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[/size][/font][*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]To uninstall, restore the backed-up file or worst case scenario, re-install the game.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
